title: Mermaid Copy and Raw Code
description: Buttons to copy the raw code or to toggle to it. Ties in with the other tasks to add image export.

comments.author: AgentSmith
comments.body: Implemented Mermaid action buttons in the shared markdown enhancement pipeline. Rendered Mermaid blocks now expose a raw-code toggle and raw-code copy button across Pages, Chat, and memory views via memorysmith.js. Validated with browser sweeps on /pages/features/chat-and-agent and /tasks, plus a Release build of MemorySmith.App.
